io_driver_functions.notes: Core DMA3 bit-serial transfer primitive to/from 0x0D000000; sets src/dst/bitcount|0x80000000 and performs an indirect jump (standard GBA EEPROM DMA3 idiom).
Low-level EEPROM block WRITE: serializes 8 bytes into a 73-bit stream (2 start + 6-bit addr + 64 data + 1 stop), transmits via FUN_0800f78c(...,0x49), busy-waits on ready bit of 0x0D000000.
Low-level EEPROM block READ: sends 9-bit request (2 start + 6-bit addr + 1 stop), clocks in 0x44=68-bit response (4 dummy + 64 data), deserializes into 4x u16 output words.

Write-verify: reads block back via FUN_0800f810 and compares word-by-word against expected data; returns 0x8000 on mismatch. Not a checksum algorithm, but the only integrity-verification function in the write path.
Write-enable/status-prep helper invoked at start of the WRITE sequence.
Write-sequence teardown/restore helper invoked at end of the WRITE sequence.
Busy-wait poll body used while waiting for the EEPROM ready bit during a write.
Mid-level ReadBlock(block, out_buf): IRQ-disable bracket (FUN_0800bcc4/bd88) + device-type select (FUN_0800f640(0,...)) around FUN_0800f810.
Mid-level WriteAndVerifyBlock(block, in_buf): same IRQ/device-select bracket around FUN_0800f960 then FUN_0800fae8; returns OR'd failure bitmask.
FALSE POSITIVE: generic 32-bit unsigned division/shift helper, no MMIO/EEPROM access, no callers traced. Excluded from the save architecture.
